reason: A local sticky-note and archive plugin for capturing categorized ideas, reflections, and TODOs with Markdown editing, history management, configurable retention, and optional sending to the current conversation.

summaries.zh: 用于记录和整理点子、感想和 TODO 的便签插件，支持 Markdown 编辑、历史归档、自动保存、保留与清理以及发送到当前对话。
summaries.en: A sticky-note plugin for capturing and organizing ideas, reflections, and TODOs with Markdown editing, automatic saving, history archiving, retention cleanup, and optional sending to the current conversation.

capabilities: Creates and updates local Markdown note files
Automatically archives and removes expired notes according to configured retention settings
Displays note history and supports editing and restoration
Sends note content to the current conversation or input box
